answer: Non-refundable submission fees make spam costly. An admission bridge verifies a fee receipt bound to one submission and rejects reuse, whether the job maps a meadow or models a zephyr. N submissions from N accounts require N fees; extra names create no free reward opportunities. Set the fee above a junk submission's expected payout, including any referral benefits. This assumes no fee refunds or signup subsidies. It deters unprofitable spam, not wealthy attackers willing to lose money.
